content.short: Linkberry helps people of poor countries have monetized social media that makes money.
content.description:
Earning a few tens of dollars a month can be invaluable to poor people in places like Africa, Latin America, and India. Linkberry helps people of poor countries have monetized social media that makes money.

First, link your YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, etc. accounts to Linkberry. Linkberry delivers your social media to numerous Linkberry users. Along with delivery, missions such as subscription, viewing, and liking are given to users. Users who complete the mission will receive Linkberry Tokens and USDM, USDA.

As users complete their missions, members' social media grows and they are able to generate profits.
